record.oneLiner: A short-snouted, single-horned predator of Cretaceous Madagascar.
record.description: Majungasaurus was an abelisaurid theropod of latest-Cretaceous Madagascar, about 7 m long, with a short, deep snout, tiny arms, and a single rounded horn on top of its skull. It was one of the last non-avian dinosaurs, and bite-marked bones show it practised cannibalism.

notableFacts.text: Had a single rounded horn on the roof of its skull.
Bite-marked bones show it fed on others of its own kind.
